newsitem.title: USA: Replacement ordered for U.S. Marines off Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Replacement ordered for U.S. Marines off Zaire.

text.p: Defense Secretary William Cohen on Friday ordered the U.S. assault ship Kearsarge with more than 1,000 Marines to replace another ship already in waters off Zaire in case Americans need to be evacuated.
The Defense Department said Cohen ordered the Kearsarge carrying part of the 22nd Marine Expeditionary Unit to leave Norfolk, Virginia, next Tuesday rather than on April 29 as previously scheduled.

It said the Kearsarge will relieve the helicopter landing ship Nassau with 1,400 Marines in waters off Zaire "to ensure continuous presence of forces capable fo conducting noncombatant evacaution operations in Zaire, if requested by the Department of State."
